senses.gloss: m. (גנס; cmp. גנז a. כנס; Syr. גסא divitiae P. Sm. 757) spoils, heaped up treasures. Pl. גִּיסִּין.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 9:7">Ex. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Esther 1:4">Esth. I, 4</cite>) <he>ששה ג׳ וכ׳</he> he showed them six collections every day, and not two of them alike; Esth.
